decisions.reason: The carpentry workshop still fits the sheltered-workshop and training base well enough that, despite commercial exposure, it remains a useful option to retain for another year of learning.
Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's core mental-health and support activities and can usually be continued with relatively low incremental commitment, so it is likely to be kept.

The retail shop is the most peripheral and market-dependent offer, and after an initial trial its learning value looks weaker than the fixed effort of keeping it open compared with other available options.
Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the eldercare portfolio and worth keeping as a young option while demand and route economics are still becoming clearer.
